metadata.name: Radiocarbon and U-series dating from archaeological sites in Borneo
metadata.description: A compilation of radiocarbon and U-series dating results from various archaeological sites across Borneo, including Malaysia (Sabah, Sarawak) and Indonesia (Kalimantan). The dataset contains sample identifiers, site names, dating methods (Radiocarbon age, U-series, U-Th), uncalibrated and calibrated ages with standard deviations, and associated references.
